progression.description: The number of words per level grows exponentially: Level 1 = 1, Level 2 = 2, Level 3 = 4, Level N = 2^(N-1)

words.clue: I shine in the sky every day, and you wait for me each morning.
Huge and blue, my waves caress the sand.
I fill the rooms when night falls.
I have doors and windows, and a roof to shelter you.
I meow, chase mice and purr in the sun.
I fall from the sky in drops that water the fields.
Birds fly in me and stars shine in me.
A land rise with a snowy peak you climb with effort.
I give you back your reflection every time you look at me.
A trip you take from one place to another.
An organ that beats nonstop and symbolizes love.
Light comes through me to see the outside.
Bright point in the sky that guides you at night.
The trail you follow to reach your destination.
A percussion instrument that sounds with rhythm and force.
Born from a cocoon, I fly with colorful wings.
A place full of books and endless knowledge.
A bright flash that crosses the sky during the storm.
A metal wind instrument with a brilliant sound.
A calendar with dates, holidays and yearly data.
Transparent and clear like spring water.
The frame of bones that supports your body.
A person who raises crops and livestock in the countryside.
The virtue of knowing your limits with simplicity.
The cold season when it snows and temperature drops.
Takes care of flowers and plants with care and soil on hands.
That gives off or receives a lot of light.
A small sweet half-moon shaped fruit, also called anacardo.
Tells stories and gives voice to tales.
A scientist who studies the seas and oceans.
A model or example that serves as a reference.
